Thor Industries, the world's largest RV manufacturer with dominant North American market shares of 39.1% in towables and 48.3% in motorhomes, has endured a severe cyclical downturn following the pandemic-era peak, with revenue declining from $16.3B in fiscal 2022 to $9.6B in fiscal 2025. However, the rate of decline has decelerated sharply to -4.6% year-over-year in fiscal 2025, backlog increased 15.1% to $1.5B, and industry forecasts project modest growth for calendar 2025-2026, suggesting potential stabilization. The company generates strong free cash flow of $456.3M (4.8% margin, exceeding net income) and has strengthened its balance sheet with net debt reduced to only $336.4M, providing financial resilience despite compressed profitability with net margin at 2.7% and ROE at 6.0%.
